svg.text: EVA v0.6 — One core, existing and persisting within a scenario-declared existence field
v0.6 adds no architecture — the same v0.5 core, bound by a scenario-declared existence field; the field's existence semantics both close the structure and open the life
scenario-declared · fixed within a life · replaceable across deployments
injected by the field, used by the layers

g.text: the field's drive set; broadcast as context
observations the field exposes to L1

svg.text: note: anchor policies / action vocabulary are field-declared too
lifecycle / tick — interruptible and recoverable · existence ≠ execution (v0.6)
one cross-layer system, multiple anchor types
constrains the candidate space up front, not post-hoc
protects lifecycle from preemption by work
formed by runtime experience · risk / identity
static L0 ＞ L1 ＞ L2 ＞ L3; dynamic weights vary with state
critical state → only L0 / L1 actions
one system, applied consistently across all layers
not one anchor per layer, but one system over many
at L3: candidate generation bounded by the anchor domain
at L4+: identity anchors join (“not an action I would take”)
the field's structural declaration ↓ closes into existence semantics
the framework only reads these 6; it does not define life and death; change the field and these 6 change with it, the core does not (structure above, life below — the single hinge)

g.text: ↓ life: decides whether the individual is alive
↑ structure: which halts can be returned from
↓ life: interruption ≠ death, same self resumes
↓ life: death of the individual (e.g. Crafter HP=0)
↑ structure: one individual vs the next
done → reset() not a silent episode boundary

svg.text: change the existence field → same core, different agent:
same core mechanism; only the field's content and these 6 semantics differ
existence semantics ↓ decide how the individual lives / is interrupted / dies / is inherited
preserve current state · inaction = safe (implicit in v0.5)
maintain future viability · inaction has a cost · take bounded action to persist through change
identity continuity lost · this individual ends
act before the threshold, not after
inaction is a trajectory to evaluate, not safe by default
recoverable across the gap ⇒ same individual; else the unrecoverability floor
classification language, not a death verdict
recoverable / terminal per level is field-declared
v0.6 = the v0.5 core, bound by a scenario-declared existence field; existence semantics is the single hinge between structure and life.
§1 active persistence · §2 hierarchy + existence semantics · §2.4 recoverable / terminal · §3.6 inheritance · §8 declaration
Counts kept distinct: 5 architecture layers (L1–L5) · 7 persistence levels (§2.2) · 6 existence-semantics (§8.4) · 8 outcome dimensions (§8.6) — four different things.
